common: This quotation is valid for the period stated above unless extended in writing by Nemora.
Work begins after receipt of the advance payment as per the payment terms.
Scope is limited to the deliverables listed. Additional features will be quoted separately.
Client shall provide required content, branding assets, and feedback within agreed timelines.
Final files / website access are handed over after clearance of the remaining balance.
Nemora retains ownership of unused design concepts; licensed deliverables transfer on full payment.

salon: Service menus, staff photos, and price lists must be provided and approved by the client before go-live.
Online booking or appointment tools only cover what is listed in scope; SMS/WhatsApp gateway fees are extra unless included.
Nemora is not responsible for missed appointments, staff scheduling, or salon operational decisions made via the site.
cafe: Menu items, prices, and allergen notes are the client's responsibility and must be kept accurate.
Food photography rights remain with the client; Nemora uses only assets the client supplies or licenses.
Online ordering or payment flows are included only if listed in the scope above.
clinic: The website does not provide medical advice; all clinical content must be approved by the client.
Doctor profiles, timings, and credentials must be verified by the client before publication.
Appointment or enquiry forms are informational unless a booking system is explicitly included in scope.
shop: Product names, prices, and stock accuracy are maintained by the client after handover.
Payment gateway charges, GST filings, and shipping rules remain the client's responsibility.
Returns / refund policy text must be provided by the client if shown on the site.
gym: Membership plans, class schedules, and trainer profiles must be supplied and approved by the client.
Nemora is not liable for injuries or fitness outcomes related to content published on the site.
Class booking or membership payment features are included only if listed in scope.
education: Course details, fees, and batch schedules must be provided and verified by the client.
Student data collected via forms will be handled as directed by the client; compliance is the client's duty.
Learning portals, live classes, or payment for courses are included only if listed in scope.
realestate: Property listings, pricing, and legal disclosures must be accurate and provided by the client.
Nemora does not broker deals or verify land titles; the site is a marketing showcase only unless otherwise scoped.
Lead forms deliver enquiries to the client; follow-up and RERA compliance remain the client's responsibility.
bakery: Product catalogues, cake prices, and seasonal menus must be supplied by the client.
Custom order / delivery workflows are included only if listed in the scope above.
Food safety claims and labelling on the site are the client's responsibility.
yoga: Class schedules, teacher bios, and fee structures must be provided and approved by the client.
Wellness content is informational; Nemora is not liable for health outcomes from published guidance.
Online booking or membership payments are included only if listed in scope.
logistics: Service areas, rates, and SLA text must be supplied by the client and kept up to date.
Tracking or courier integrations are included only if listed in the scope above.
Nemora is not liable for shipment delays or losses handled by the client's operations.
temple: Event notices, donation purposes, and trust details must be approved by authorised temple / trust representatives.
Online donation or seva booking features are included only if listed in scope; payment gateway fees are extra unless included.
Religious content accuracy and community communications remain the client's responsibility.
pg: Room types, rents, deposits, and house rules must be provided accurately by the client.
Tenant enquiries via forms are passed to the client; screening and agreements remain the client's duty.
Booking or rent-payment features are included only if listed in the scope above.

premium: Where hosting is included, it covers the period stated in scope (typically 12 months from go-live); renewal is billed separately unless agreed in writing.
